backend/main.mo: Main Motoko backend actor implementing e-commerce functionality with products, blog posts, newsletter signups, user profiles, admin authentication, access control, and HTML parsing for Amazon product metadata extraction with priority-based field extraction and validation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three badge container resize features in Hero.tsx and TrustBadges.tsx components to fix badge cutoff issues, with high confidence and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including React components, hooks, styling, and admin interfaces with details on routing, authentication, product management, blog management, and improved contrast/accessibility features.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN optimizations including auto minify, Brotli compression, Rocket Loader, caching rules, image optimization, HTTP/3, and mobile-specific settings with verification and troubleshooting instructions.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Deployment troubleshooting documentation covering production failure root cause (missing favicon reference), resolution steps, and comprehensive go-live checklist for version 84 including static assets, build verification, service worker, and functionality checks.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Card, structured data for Kolkata-based fashion e-commerce, and preloaded critical assets for performance.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Performance optimization action plan targeting Lighthouse scores of 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop, identifying current issues (large JS bundles, unoptimized images, render-blocking CSS) and outlining Phase 1 quick wins including Cloudflare optimizations.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Comprehensive performance optimization guide documenting implemented techniques including critical path rendering, advanced image optimization with OptimizedImage component, code splitting with React.lazy, service worker caching strategies, Core Web Vitals tracking, and CSS/animation optimizations.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt file allowing all crawlers and pointing to sitemap.xml.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap with a single homepage entry for SEO indexing.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets (images, JS, CSS) and network-first for HTML/API, with versioned cache management and special handling for robots.txt/sitemap.xml.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with lazy-loaded routes (home, products, admin, sitemap), authentication handling, and route-based rendering logic including 404 page.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Admin interface for creating, editing, and deleting blog posts with form validation and featured post toggle.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Admin panel for viewing newsletter subscribers with CSV export functionality and subscriber count display.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin interface for managing products with CRUD operations, category mapping, form validation, and dialogs for adding/editing/deleting products.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Admin component for managing site pages (privacy policy, terms of service, contact) with form inputs for titles and content, using bulk update mutations and default content initialization.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login modal component with username/password form, error handling, and authentication integration via useAuth hook.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel with tabbed interface for managing products, blog posts, newsletter, and site pages; includes admin permission check and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal dialog for displaying full blog post content with author, date metadata, loading/error states, and scrollable article view.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Displays a grid of up to 3 featured blog posts with loading state, post metadata (author, date), and a 'Read More' button that triggers a callback with the blog ID.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with company info, quick links, newsletter subscription form, trust badges, social media links, and legal/policy links with modal triggers.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, site title, and navigation links (Home, Products, Admin Panel) that uses client-side routing via history API.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero banner section with gradient background, headline, CTA buttons to scroll to products, and trust badges (SSL, Amazon Verified, Fast Delivery).
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Image component with lazy loading via IntersectionObserver, WebP format support with PNG fallback, responsive sizes, and preloading for priority images.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal component that fetches and displays static page content (privacy policy, terms, contact) with default fallback content and loading state.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a grid of fashion products with filtering, sorting, and category selection. Includes memoized ProductCard components with badges, pricing, and Amazon affiliate links.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Displays customer testimonials and a rotating carousel of recent purchases to build trust and social proof.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: Simple SVG-based loading spinner component with customizable className and accessibility attributes.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: Renders trust badges (SSL, Amazon verified, genuine, return guarantee, etc.) in horizontal or vertical layout with lazy-loaded images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor with Internet Identity authentication, automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand-based authentication hook with persistent session storage, providing login/logout functions and session verification using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Custom hooks providing debounced values and debounced callback functions with configurable delay (default 300ms).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for product CRUD operations, admin checks, and data fetching with optimized caching (5min stale time, 10min cache time).
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system for gold/navy theme, dark mode support, and optimized font/image rendering utilities.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for web-vitals library metrics (CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, TTFB) and report handlers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that handles authentication flow, checks admin privileges using useIsCallerAdmin hook, and conditionally renders AdminLogin or AdminPanel with loading and access denied states.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Products listing page with a gradient header section and ProductGrid component to display the complete collection of fashion, jewelry, and accessories.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Sitemap page that fetches XML sitemap data via useGetSitemap hook and replaces the entire document with raw XML content for SEO purposes.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility to delay third-party script injection by 3 seconds after page load to improve Core Web Vitals and initial render performance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color schemes (gold, navy), OKLCH color space, extended theme settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration with React plugin, proxy setup for ICP backend, optimized production builds with code splitting, terser minification, and manual chunk definitions for vendors.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document indicating an e-commerce app with known issues including badge container cutoffs and product loading errors, with pending fix requests for both issues.
